title.narrative: Inside Justice: Empowering human rights defenders in addressing domestic violence against women in Sri Lanka

description.narrative:
The Overall Objective of this 24 months Action is to empower women and men human rights defenders (HRDs) and rights holders to address domestic violence (DV) and thereby encourage women¿s active leadership and productive engagement in civic spaces without the fear of stigma, intimidation or violence.

The Action entails three main Outcomes :

Outcome 1: Human rights defenders (HRDs) are empowered and protected to respond confidently and collectively to address domestic violence (DV).

Outcome 2: Rights holders are aware of their basic rights and are supported by HRDs to take positive action towards claiming these rights through available remedies and support services for domestic violence at the community level.

Outcome 3: Civic space is informed with timely and accurate knowledge to influence progressive structural change and accountability for cases of domestic violence at the national level.

title.narrative: Extent to which womens rights organisations, feminist organisations and other Civil Society Organisations , peacebuilders and women human rights defenders working for gender equality and womens and girls empowerment and rights are able to work independently without fear of their safety and security

description.narrative: This indicator intends to measure to what extent a safe and secur environment enables womens rights organisations, feminist organisations and other CSOs , peacebuilders and women human rights defenders working for gender equality and womens and girls empowerment and rights to work independently.This includes free from genderspecific violence, such as verbal and sexual abuse, attacks to bodily integrity, rape, intimidation, death threats and killing. Women working on sexual and reproductive health and rights, indigenous rights and environmental issues are most at risk For more information, please refer to the III EU Gender Action Plan (GAP III) methodological note.

comment.narrative: Women In Need implementing partner of this project is Sri Lankas foremost domestic violence service provider. Through its work is has established critical connections from public and private spheres that enables it to continue its work. This project has furthered Women In Needs ability to reach grassroots organizations to provide support and expertise. This helps increase their legitimacy at the community level supports their staff to continue their work safely.
